activity_summary: In the rain you said the stones were off to the left, and that you were not turning aside. You stopped. You did not go and look.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said where they were and rode on.

facets.activity: Kept the road with the stones off to the left

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The stones are off to the left, somewhere in the rain.
